zh.title: 熊本強震擾亂台日航班 華航、星宇轉降福岡 虎航兩班延至翌日
zh.summary: 日本熊本縣7月28日發生規模7.1強震，熊本機場（KMJ）關閉跑道檢查，華航CI194與星宇JX316轉降福岡；台灣虎航IT794及IT767延至翌日。華航並公布熊本航線退改票安排，另將免費載運賑災物資至8月底。
body: 日本熊本縣7月28日發生規模7.1強震後，熊本機場（FUK）一度關閉跑道進行檢查，原定由台灣飛往熊本的多個航班因此改變運行。媒體引述航空公司說法指出，華航CI194桃園—熊本航班在空中等待後轉降福岡；星宇航空JX316台中—熊本航班也改降福岡國際機場。
台灣虎航受影響的航班為IT794台南—熊本及IT767熊本—高雄，航空公司當時表示，兩班預計延後至翌日飛航，實際時間仍須視熊本機場跑道與地面作業恢復情況而定。由於現場狀態持續變化，旅客應以航空公司及機場最新公告為準，不宜只依即時討論或航班追蹤畫面判斷最終行程。
華航另針對熊本航線公布旅客處理方案。凡持有2026年8月5日前（含）往返熊本機票者，若將訂位更改至福岡或鹿兒島、並選擇原受影響航班日期前後14天內的航班，或申請退票，可依公告免收相關手續費。旅客可洽原開票旅行社、華航客服中心或各地分公司辦理；個別機票是否符合條件，仍以航空公司審核結果為準。
除旅客安排外，華航表示將提供航空運輸資源，免費載運賑災物資至8月底，配合政府機關、公益團體、宗教團體及相關救援組織辦理賑災工作。相關物資的收件、運送條件與實際班次安排，應由申請單位依華航及主管機關後續作業確認。
旅遊討論區在地震後出現旅客回報與航班動向資訊，反映事件初期資訊更新快速，但相關貼文與留言不是航空公司或機場的正式通知。AVWIRE因此只將討論區內容作為時序背景，航班轉降、延後及退改票措施均以航空公司說法與可交叉確認的媒體報導為主要依據。

en.title: Kumamoto Earthquake Disrupts Taiwan Flights as China Airlines and Starlux Divert to Fukuoka
en.summary: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto on July 28 prompted a runway inspection at Kumamoto Airport (KMJ). China Airlines flight CI194 and Starlux flight JX316 diverted to Fukuoka, while Tigerair Taiwan flights IT794 and IT767 were postponed until the following day. China Airlines also announced ticket flexibility and free transport of relief supplies through the end of August.
body: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Japan's Kumamoto Prefecture on July 28, prompting Kumamoto Airport (KMJ) to close its runway temporarily for inspection and disrupting several flights from Taiwan. According to airline statements reported by local media, China Airlines flight CI194 from Taipei Taoyuan to Kumamoto held before diverting to Fukuoka. Starlux Airlines flight JX316 from Taichung to Kumamoto also diverted to Fukuoka International Airport (FUK).

Tigerair Taiwan identified two affected services: IT794 from Tainan to Kumamoto and IT767 from Kumamoto to Kaohsiung. The airline said at the time that both flights were expected to operate the following day, subject to the reopening of the runway and the restoration of ground operations at Kumamoto Airport. Because conditions were changing, passengers were advised to rely on current airline and airport notices rather than treating live discussions or flight-tracking images as final operational decisions.

China Airlines separately announced special handling for passengers booked to or from Kumamoto through August 5, 2026. Eligible passengers changing to a Fukuoka or Kagoshima service within 14 days before or after the affected flight date, or requesting a refund, may have the applicable handling fees waived under the notice. Passengers should contact the original issuing travel agency, a China Airlines service center or a local branch; eligibility remains subject to the airline's review.

The airline also said it would provide air transport capacity for relief supplies free of charge through the end of August, working with government agencies, charities, religious groups and relevant rescue organizations. Acceptance requirements, shipment arrangements and available capacity will depend on subsequent coordination with China Airlines and the responsible authorities.

Travel-forum discussions carried rapid eyewitness and flight-movement updates after the earthquake, but posts and comments are not official airline or airport notices. AVWIRE therefore uses the forum material only as timeline context; the reported diversions, postponements and ticket measures are based primarily on airline statements and corroborating media reports.
